title: CS50x: Introduction to Computer Science
description: An intellectual introduction to computer science and programming. Learn how to think algorithmically and solve problems efficiently using C, Python, SQL, and web technologies.

modules.title: Week 0: Scratch & Computational Thinking
Week 1: C Syntax, Data Types & Operators
